title: Murasaki
tagline: Bridge between Polygon zkEVM and Layer1 using Hyperlane. In addition, Wrap route can be used to easily issue tokens that can be used in various chains
description:
Easy communication between zkEVM and Layer 1 using permissionless deployment of Hyperlane
The use of Hyperlane will also greatly facilitate integration with other L1 chains in the future.
In addition, Wrap route can be used to easily issue tokens that can be used in various chains
how_its_made:
Build new endpoints, validators, and relayers for Bridge using Hyperlane's permissionless depolyment to allow connection to other chains.
The use of Hyperlane will also greatly facilitate integration with other L1 chains in the future.
In addition, Wrap route can be used to easily issue tokens that can be used in various chains
